fallback: If eligible known SAR overlaps are exhausted, select previously unreserved visual/RV sources by descending UTC then identity in eligible training geography; no SAR overlap is inferred.

public_sources.purpose: Published temporal range, source description and citation requirements
Public archive listing; inspect availability of newer observation years
Check whether the public gallery exposes object-level date/position evidence
Locate primary reconnaissance documentation; report existence alone is not object corroboration

limits: Bounded discovery using existing source observations and cached SAR catalogue overlaps, not an exhaustive search of NL icebergs.
Visual/RV methods with satellite source prefixes are excluded; the CSV alone lacks observer logs, photographs and calibrated position error.
Source/SAR timing is catalogue midpoint screening, not native reflector identity or annotation.
Optical requests cover plus/minus one hour around source time and a 3900 m discovery envelope; this heuristic is not a calibrated drift confidence interval.
Footprints, scene cloud percentages, repeated publisher reports and public photo galleries do not establish visibility or same-object identity.
Failed and truncated requests cannot establish zero coverage. No new optical or SAR pixels are interpreted.
Historical A/B leads cannot establish C/D class performance or Kaggle preprocessing equivalence.
Existing labels remain provisional and ignored for accuracy; no label, reservation, training export or promotion is created.
